csv_scope_of_work: This Design-Build Project i in Frederick County along I-81 between Mile Marker (MM) 317 to 319, The project is a bundle of three elements, and the three elements are part of single procurement and will be awarded as a single contract. Following s the brief description of each element: (1) 81 Widening MM 317-319: 181 will be expanded from two to three lanes each way between MM 317-319 to improve safety, reliability, and capacity. The project includes three bridge pairs (CSX rai, US 11, Winchester & Western rail), and raising the interstate profile to meet clearance over Route 11. This element also includes two large box culverts that provide floodplain conveyance beneath I-81. (2) Exit 317 Interchange Improvements: The existing I-81/US 11 diamond interchange will be converted to a diverging diamond interchange to reduce congestion, queues, and safety issues that currently extend onto I-81. The bundled project includes three bridge pairs at CSX rail, US 11, and Winchester & Western rail crossings; raising the interstate profile to achieve clearance over Route 11; two large box culverts for floodplain conveyance beneath I-81; and conversion of the existing I-81/US 11 diamond interchange at Exit 317 into a diverging diamond interchange.
